MOZ.note: Article states nothing on this question for Mozambique.
The link described is civil register to hospital births module, not to the ID system.

facts.fact: Jornal Notícias reports e-SIRCEV, the electronic civil registration system, was already linked to the hospital births module in some Inhambane districts, with the link launched for expansion to the whole country in July 2024.
